agreement_detail.both_sign_note: Both parties sign, or the agreement never takes effect — the record itself refuses an active contract with a missing signature.
agreement_detail.cosign_note_signed: The other party has signed. Your countersignature puts this agreement into effect.
agreement_detail.cosign_note_unsigned: Your signature will be recorded. The agreement takes effect only after both parties sign.
agreement_detail.history_note: This instrument is {status} — it is history, and can no longer be negotiated.
agreement_detail.intro: One instrument, on the record: the parties, the terms, and both signatures. The floor beneath it cannot be lowered by any clause.
agreement_detail.negotiation_note_after: — the parties re-sign the changed text. No clause may waive a constitutional right.
agreement_detail.negotiation_note_before: The terms above are the agreed base. A change is proposed as a redline; when the other party accepts, it amends the instrument and
agreement_detail.parties_only: This agreement is visible to its parties only.

agreement_detail.review_before_sign: Review the terms above before signing for {name}.
agreement_detail.rights_body: No clause in this or any agreement can waive, sell, or sign away a constitutional right — voting, candidacy, residency, petitioning, due process. A clause that tries is void in that part; the rest stands. No agreement may attach a fee or cost to exercising a civic right.

agreements.group_resident_hint: Agreements you offered or were invited to sign.

exchange.none_for_sale: No shares are offered for sale right now. A holder lists some below; a buyer takes the whole offer at its fixed price — money and units move together or not at all.
exchange.offer_desc: You hold equity you can resell. List some at a fixed per-unit price; a buyer takes the whole offer. You cannot offer more than you hold.

exchange.quantity_hint: Enter a positive quantity with up to six decimal places.

help.intro: Ask for support, offer your time or skills, and agree with someone on the help they need.
help.need_hint: Describe the task, timing and what a helper should know.
help.privacy_note: Public requests are visible in the market. Replies are private between the requester and each person offering help. You can publish a draft later.
help.responding_hint: Open a public request to offer help.

help_detail.accept_note: Selecting this offer closes the request to other helpers until it is completed or the selected helper withdraws.
help_detail.no_response_you: You have no response on this page.
help_detail.offer_hint: Describe what you can do and when. Only you and the requester can read this reply.
help_detail.publish_note: This draft is visible only to you. Publishing makes its title and description visible in the public market so people can offer help.
help_detail.resolve_note: Mark completed when the help has been provided. This records the outcome; it does not transfer money or sign an agreement.
joint_ledgers.co_owners_ids_label: Co-owners' account ids (comma or space separated)
joint_ledgers.fund_before: Fund it: send a plain transfer to account
joint_ledgers.intro: A joint ledger is a co-owned account: its balance belongs to more than one party, and no movement leaves it until every required co-owner agrees. One signer can never move shared money alone — a movement is proposed, waits, and settles only when the ledger's approval rule is met.
joint_ledgers.money_enters_note: Money enters a joint ledger the ordinary way: a plain transfer to its account. The ledger holds and moves the unit; it never issues it.
joint_ledgers.movement_pending: {approvals} of {needed} agreed — held until the agreement is complete.
joint_ledgers.movement_settled: Settled {when} — the agreement completed and the money moved.
joint_ledgers.new_ledger_desc: Name the co-owners and the approval rule up front. You are always a signer of a ledger you open; the other co-owners join as their account ids — the same way a transfer names its recipient.
joint_ledgers.no_movements_before: No movements yet. Any new one will need
joint_ledgers.none_yet: None yet — you are not a co-owner of any joint ledger, and no public one exists in this world.
joint_ledgers.private_note: A private ledger is readable only by its co-owners — like a ballot.
joint_ledgers.propose_note: Proposing signs it. It settles only when the rule is met — your signature alone moves nothing.
joint_ledgers.public_ledger_option: Public ledger — anyone may watch it (a jurisdiction-style shared fund)
joint_ledgers.rail_1_body: A single co-owner can never move shared money — the movement waits until the approval rule is met.
joint_ledgers.rail_2_body: Parties set their own rule and purpose, but no clause may waive a right.
joint_ledgers.rail_2_strong: Freedom to contract, with a floor.
joint_ledgers.rail_3_body: The balance lives in an ordinary account on the public hash-chained ledger; funding and settlement are ordinary balanced transfers. There is no special joint money.
joint_ledgers.rail_4_body: An underfunded ledger refuses a movement the same way a wallet refuses an overdraft.
joint_ledgers.rail_5_body: A joint ledger holds and moves the unit; it never issues it.
joint_ledgers.rails_title: The rails that hold a joint ledger
joint_ledgers.step_propose_body: Any co-owner proposes a movement out — a payment, a transfer, a drawdown. Proposing counts as their signature.
joint_ledgers.step_settle_body: The approval that meets the rule — all signers, or a majority, as agreed at opening — moves the money in the same act.
joint_ledgers.step_wait_body: The movement is held while the remaining co-owners decide. Each approval is on the record.
joint_ledgers.title: Joint ledgers
listing.buyers_accounts_note: Buyers are shown as accounts. You are told which order to accept, not who placed it. Settling moves the money and the thing in one transaction.
listing.cant_order_own: You can't order your own goods.
listing.cgc_badge_note: The common-good badge is informational: a CGC trades on identical terms to private enterprise, never a different rule.
listing.listing_closed: This listing is closed, or you don't have a wallet in this currency yet.
listing.no_longer_available: This listing is no longer available.
listing.no_pending_orders: No pending orders on this page.
listing.ordering_note: Ordering doesn't move anything on its own. The seller accepts, and then money and thing move together — both, or neither.
listing.org_trades: An organization trades under its own name — its listing is its public act.
listing.person_account_note: A person selling is shown as an account, not a name. Linking an account to a person is deliberately not something this page can do.

market.goods_note: Goods must use an item you hold. Items with an open listing are excluded.

market.no_currency_body: Nothing can be priced until this world's root legislature defines a currency.
market.no_work: No work is being offered right now.
market.nobody_asking: Nobody is asking for help right now.
market.nothing_for_sale: Nothing is for sale right now.

org_settings.conversions_desc: When ownership changes form, the authorizing act records the minimum fair-market value and how it was calculated (Art. III §5). Those records appear here.
org_settings.dues_changes_note: Changes are recorded in this organization's history. Set the amount to zero to charge no dues.
org_settings.dues_desc: Voluntary membership dues are a private subscription between a member and an organization that chooses to charge them. A due is a membership obligation — never a tax, never a share. It is paid as an ordinary transfer from the member's own wallet.
org_settings.intro: Review this organization's dues, shares, and financial records. Its agent can update dues and issue shares for a stock organization.
org_settings.issue_shares_note: Select a recipient and enter the new units. This adds public ownership and changes existing ownership percentages.
org_settings.ledger_desc: Review the organization's balance and payment history. Other parties are identified by account to protect their financial privacy.
org_settings.ledger_restricted: The wallet ledger and levies are visible to the organization's agent and its seated board.
org_settings.levies_restricted: Levy filings are visible to the organization's agent and its seated board.
org_settings.no_account: This organization holds no economic account yet — it opens when the org first transacts.
org_settings.no_conversions: No ownership conversions on this page.
org_settings.no_levy_filings: No levy filings on this page.
org_settings.no_ownership_entries: No ownership entries on this page. Return to the first page to refresh.
org_settings.no_recipients: No matching recipients on this page.
org_settings.ownership_failed: The ownership records could not be loaded.
org_settings.rail_gate_body: No due may attach to voting, candidacy, residency, or petitioning (Art. I · Art. II §8).
org_settings.rail_gate_strong: Never a gate on a right.
org_settings.rail_optin_body: A member joins and leaves freely; if dues lapse the membership ends — no right is ever withheld.
org_settings.rail_paid_body: Members make a dues payment each period. Payments are not automatic.
org_settings.search_by_name: Search by public name to select a person or organization.
org_settings.search_failed: The search could not be completed.
org_settings.share_units_help: A positive amount with up to six decimal places. This action does not collect payment.
org_settings.shares_entry_note: Each entry is one recorded ownership stake. A holder may have several entries.
org_settings.shares_note_after: — never a currency (that is reserved to the most-encompassing jurisdiction, Art. V §5). Ownership is a public fact recorded by name; the money that changes hands when a share trades stays on the private wallet ledger.
org_settings.taxes_desc: What the organization has declared and been assessed under public revenue law (Art. V §4). How a levy is computed — its base and rate — is public.
org_settings.title: {name} — finances
request_detail.after_applying_body: The organization reviews your application and offers terms. You accept and sign as the worker, then the organization countersigns to activate the work agreement. The terms remain private.
request_detail.apply_note: Only you and the organization can read your application. Applying does not create a contract.
request_detail.before_apply_prefix: You need an account in this world's currency to apply. Check
request_detail.closed_body: This organization is no longer taking applications for this work.
request_detail.codetermination_note: Ongoing work also counts toward worker representation. This organization's current rules provide the first worker seat at {first} workers and equal worker and owner representation at {parity} workers.
request_detail.intro: Review the work and send a private application to the organization.
request_detail.recorded_after: for its status, any offered terms and the resulting agreement.

resident_agreements.review_intro: Review the terms, signatures and proposed changes with the other parties.

stipend.classes_desc: A bump attaches to a fact about what a person is doing — never to who they are. Stacking them can never exceed the {cap} cap.
stipend.examples_desc: Same floor for all; the spread is only the duty differential. These are computed by the live formula on example role sets — they are illustrations, not anyone's receipt.
stipend.formula_line1: amount = floor + min( Σ eligible-role bumps, cap )
stipend.intro: A differential, not a salary. Everyone associated by residency receives the same floor; on top of it, those carrying certain duties receive a small recognition bump. Because pay can never become a qualification for office, the differential is add-only, capped, and writes nothing but the private ledger — it grants no seat, no vote, no advantage.
stipend.k_anon_note: Only the total and the head-count publish. A class with fewer than {floor} recipients is folded into the general total and never published on its own — a small class would identify its members.
stipend.my_wallet_line: My wallet — see your own line
stipend.no_run_yet: No run has happened yet — the aggregate appears with the first one.
stipend.node_operator_basis: Keeps a node of this world running — the infrastructure duty.
stipend.not_yet_run: not yet run in this world
stipend.numbers_desc_after: — a supermajority of the chamber AND the consent of the people it governs. Because the constituents' own money is spent, they must agree.
stipend.numbers_desc_before: The current values, on the record. Nobody edits these on a settings screen: each one moves only when
stipend.numbers_title: The numbers, and how they change
stipend.office_holder_basis: Holds a serving civic office — legislator, executive, judge, board.
stipend.office_holder_who: Every civic role-holder, no subset. A bump ends the day the duty ends.
stipend.private_receipt_body: Each person's own amount writes only to their own private wallet.
stipend.propose_change: Propose a change — the settings register
stipend.propose_note: That drafts a proposal for the chamber (F-LEG-031). It never saves a default.
stipend.short_paid: That run was short-paid: the treasury could not cover it in full, so everyone received the same fraction — never the first N in line.
stipend.switched_off_body: A legislature turned the stipend off by act. The formula below is what would apply if it were switched back on — the switch itself is a legislative decision, not a setting anyone edits.
stipend.title: Civic stipend
stipend.who_receives_body: It is the same gate that unlocks voting and candidacy: an absolute right, no means test, no application, no qualification of any kind.
stipend.who_receives_strong: Who receives it — residency, and nothing else.

units.clock_note: The economic clock runs on a {interval} cycle; the next disbursement is due {when}.
units.collected_from: Collected from {from} to {to}. A refresh keeps this completed report visible until the replacement is ready.
units.collection_stopped: Collection stopped. Resume to continue from the last saved step.
units.intro: Review the currency, its recorded rules and the latest completed money report.
units.issued_by: Issued by {issuer} — currency is root-reserved (Art. V §5).
units.levers_note: Each of these can be changed only by a passed act, recorded publicly, and only within the bounds shown. There is no way to set one directly — not for an operator, not for an administrator, not from this page.
units.no_currency_body: This world's root legislature hasn't defined one.
units.no_levers: No monetary levers are defined in this world.
units.no_subdivisions: No subdivisions are defined — the whole {unit} is the only named measure. A legislature defines one by act, like any monetary lever.
units.precision_note: Shown to {precision} decimal places. The ledger keeps more than that internally, so nothing is lost to rounding — only hidden from the display.
units.rates_note: Both are targets a legislature sets, not forces of nature. Either can be changed by an act, within bounds it cannot exceed.
units.report_desc: These figures describe accounts. Balances are collected over time while transactions can continue; they are not an instant ledger reconciliation. The report does not change money or rates.
units.report_not_started: No report has been collected yet.
units.subdivisions_desc: How the unit divides is the legislature's to define, the same way weights and measures are. A named subdivision is a display convention on the same ledger — never a second currency.
units.telemetry_note: The top tenth uses the funded balances collected for this report. Turnover uses recorded transfers in the 30 days ending when collection began. No account holder or location is disclosed.
units.title: Units & money
units.worth_basis: What the unit is worth, as enacted: {basis}
wallet.caption_assets: Items in your account on this page, in name order
wallet.caption_tx: Your transactions, newest first — 20 per page
wallet.divides_after: — display conventions on the same ledger, never a second currency.
wallet.find_item_label: Find an item by the beginning of its name
wallet.intro: What you hold, and where it came from. This page is yours alone — balances are private in the same way a ballot is, and no one else can look yours up.
wallet.make_note: Registering a thing gives it its own identity and a provenance record — every hand it passes through is kept. Then you can offer it on the market.
wallet.no_currency_body: This world's root legislature hasn't defined one, so there is nothing to hold.
wallet.no_items_held: You are not holding any registered items.
wallet.no_items_start: No items start with “{query}”. Try another beginning or clear the search.
wallet.no_receipts: No stipend receipts on this page.
wallet.no_subdivisions: No subdivisions are defined yet — how the unit divides is the legislature's measurement-standards power.
wallet.no_wallet_body: A wallet opens once your residency is confirmed. If you've just declared where you live, it arrives when the confirmation does.
wallet.no_wallet_title: You don't have a wallet yet
wallet.search_failed: The item search could not be completed. Try again.
wallet.send_note: You send to an account, not to a name — the same way a ballot is separated from a voter. There is no overdraft: sending more than you hold is refused, not borrowed.
wallet.title: My wallet
wallet.worth_basis: What a {name} is worth, as enacted: {basis}.
wallet.your_account_after: — the id someone else needs to send you money.
